inspect-animations-idle.idle.title: Inspect Animations Idle
inspect-animations-idle.idle.enabled.too: Master switch: after the first idle timeout passes without a trigger, an inspection plays automatically.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.section.act: Action triggers (suggested by your own actions)
inspect-animations-idle.idle.first_secon: Idle time before the very first auto animation, in seconds.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.next_second: Idle time before every auto animation after the first, in seconds.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.head_turn_d: How many degrees the camera must turn within one tick for inactivity to reset.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.trigger.slo: Hotbar slot changes - keys 1-9, the mouse wheel and programmatic switches - reset the timer.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.trigger.ite: Using an item (right click) resets the timer; it keeps resetting while the button is held.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.trigger.att: Every attack click (left mouse) resets the timer.
While the left mouse button is held, the timer keeps resetting (block breaking, repeated attacks).
inspect-animations-idle.idle.trigger.off: The offhand swap key (F by default) resets the timer.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.trigger.ite: Replacing, re-equipping or moving the stack in the selected hotbar slot or the offhand slot resets the timer.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.trigger.spr: While sprinting, the timer keeps resetting.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.trigger.wal: Any deliberate movement (walking forward or strafing) resets the timer.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.trigger.cro: While sneaking, the timer keeps resetting.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.trigger.hea: Turning the camera resets the timer; the required angle is set by the slider right below.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.trigger.cre: While flying in creative or spectator mode, the timer keeps resetting.
inspect-animations-idle.idle.trigger.ely: While flying with an elytra, the timer keeps resetting.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.inspect-a: Expands Inspect Animations with idle auto-animations: after a configurable inaction timeout, a random action plays - either the currently selected animation or the Turn animation. Two timeouts are available: the first one after activity stops and the one used for every subsequent animation. Inactivity can be reset by many configurable triggers: item use (RMB/LMB), slot switching, offhand swap, replacing the held item, and optional state triggers such as walking, sprinting, sneaking, camera turns, creative flight or elytra flight. The mod also ships four item tags for tagging items in the Inspect Animations per-item animation settings. Requires the Inspect Animations mod by SoundsoftheSun (supported: 0.2.5 to 0.2.x).
